body:
The human set role models on the Settings page, but the model pickers don't start on them. The human suspects Settings isn't saving.

### Scope
- Reproduce first. Set a role model in Settings, reload Settings, and check that the choice is still shown. Then open a task in Planning, Assigned and Review, and the Strategy page, and check each picker.
- Fix whatever breaks: saving, reading back, or the pickers.
- Add a test that fails on the old behaviour.

### Leads (from a read of the code, not confirmed)
- Saving looks right on paper: `settings.update` (`ChooseRoleModel`) POSTs to `/role-models`, `board::setup.save_role_model` writes `role_models.<role>.default` to the machine-wide config, and `board::setup.role_models` reads it back from the same `config_path()`.
- `solace_task.role_models_chosen` picks the default only if the model is `available`. Otherwise it picks nothing. Settings lists every set-up model, so a model that can't start right now would save fine but show nothing in the picker.
- `solace_task.main_role` gives a role only for the Planning, Assigned and Review columns (`board::task_model.main_action`). The Strategy page uses the `strategist` role (`strategy.choose_plan_model`).
- The task page re-reads role models on connect and on each task refresh (`solace_task.refresh`). Check that a change made in Settings reaches an already-open task.

### Out of scope
Falling back to another model when the default can't start.
title: role models: defaults not picked up
